findings.title: Partial pending-barrier failure skips other actor paid outcome collection
findings.scenario: A submitted and pending; B prepare/prove/pending validation fails. Finally resumes sequencer and awaits caught submissions, so A can become canonically included. Original exception then bypasses two-account collection. Outer catch inspects only activeActor B, losing A canonical receipt/effect/fee while its report row remains outcome unknown.
findings.repair: Preserve primary exception; resume/settle with separately retained failure, then attempt bounded read-only canonical receipt/effect/fee collection for every actor whose submission started, on success and failure. Do not let first collection error skip second; no financial retry. Preserve independent unknown/unavailable result when lookup fails.
findings.regression: Labelled A pending→included with B prepare/prove failure must retain A receipt/effect/fee plus original B failure and attempt both applicable reads. Resume failure must not replace original error or allow unobserved async writers after cleanup.

findings.title: Observer acceptance is not revalidated at terminal close
findings.scenario: match succeeds, then another intercepted completion changes errors/conflicts before cleanup. Close restores and snapshots without requiring clean counters or rechecking exact canonical tuple; report can remain passed despite observer being poisoned under its fail-closed contract.
findings.repair: At terminal close/snapshot require no pending/errors/conflicts/truncation/ownership loss and revalidate stored canonical loser tuple before allowing report passed. Always close/record failures without masking earlier error.
findings.regression: After an initially matching observation inject later conflicting result/error/pending or ownership loss; final campaign acceptance fails while cleanup still runs.
